I arrived for my scheduled appointment, checked in, and then waited for over an hour without being called in. Several people who arrived after me were seen before me, and no one gave me any updates.

When I asked at reception, I was told the doctor was running late. Another 30 minutes later, after I asked again, they said the doctor was having computer issues. I felt too unwell to keep waiting and eventually had to leave without being seen.
